card.name: Web address pieces and click-here directions
card.fires_on: Parts of a web address such as .com, .net, youtube or learn inside a URL. It also fires on words that point a reader to a resource or an action, like 'go to Shop' or 'by clicking'.

modes.label: Inside URLs
modes.description: The domain ending or a piece of the domain in a written web address.

modes.label: Direction words
modes.description: A word in an instruction telling the reader where to go or what to click.
modes.example: To acquire a copy, please go to<< Shop>> at EDNF.
